status: Design configuration only; not wired to runtime

invariants: two long ears with pink inner ears

story_policy.prepare: Copy current identity and explicit edits into one image job; exclude unrelated dialogue/personal identifiers
story_policy.edit: Explicit child edit creates next appearance_revision, overrides only the changed attribute and cancels obsolete jobs
story_policy.display: At final consumption compare current appearance_revision plus session/turn/topic validity; static hash is not a consistency test
story_policy.quality: Check species/color/distinctive features/accessories on every prepared scene; reject or reuse an approved matching picture if wrong
story_policy.clear: Delete all story identities, edits and prepared outputs at session end/expiry
